annotations.title: JSON to types (TypeScript, Go, Python, Zod)

description: Generate type definitions from a JSON sample: TypeScript interfaces (or type aliases), Go structs with json tags (initialisms like ID/URL, pointers for optional/nullable, optional omitempty), Python dataclasses (snake_case fields with the original key noted) and Zod schemas. All items of an array are merged into one type (missing keys become optional, null makes a field nullable, int+float → number/float64, mixed values → unions); identical shapes share one name. These four are every language the website supports. Give "text" or a file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/json-to-types/

export.description: TypeScript / Zod: add the export keyword.

language.description: Output language, or "all" for all four.

output.description: Optional: write the code to this file (with language "all", the four outputs joined by headers).

path.description: Or: a path to a JSON file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

rootName.description: Name of the top-level type (turned into PascalCase).

text.description: The JSON sample as inline text.

tsTypeAlias.description: TypeScript: use "type X = {…}" instead of "interface X {…}".
